name: titan
description: Next.js 15 fullstack template with better-auth for authentication and drizzle-orm as the orm

documents.title: Introducción
documents.text: Titan Next.js 15 fullstack template with better-auth for authentication and drizzle-orm as the ORM. [!WARNING] This project uses Next.js 15-canary to support node runtime on middleware. This is not yet supported in stable version.

documents.title: Tech Stack
documents.text: - Full-stack framework: Next.js 15-canary - UI: Tailwind CSS v4 - Component library: Shadcn UI - Authentication: better-auth - Database: postgres - ORM: drizzle-orm

documents.title: Features
documents.text: - Authentication - Social login - Google - Github - Discord - Database - Postgres (Neon) - ORM: drizzle-orm - Next.js API, server actions, and middleware

documents.title: Getting Started
documents.text: Clone the repository Install dependencies Create environment file Provide environment variables in .env file - BETTER AUTH SECRET : Secret key for Better Auth authentication generate one here - BETTER AUTH URL : Better Auth URL (e.g., http://localhost:3000 ) - DATABASE URL : PostgreSQL connection string provided from Neon (e.g., postgresql://username:password@neon:5432/titan ) Generate database schema Migrate database Run the development server Open the browser and navigate to http://localhost:3000

documents.title: Using a Local Database
documents.text: Have Docker installed on your system. Before running the db:generate command from Getting Started, run the following command in the project directory to start a local database: Use the following environment variables in .env file: - DATABASE URL : postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/titan Add the pg and @types/pg dependencies to your project: Then, change the /src/lib/db/index.ts file to use the drizzle-orm/node-postgres and pg package instead of @neondatabase/serverless : Continue steps from Getting Started e.g. generating the database schema, applying migrations, and running the dev server. Open the browser and navigate to http://localhost:3000
